title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #19

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   B. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
   C. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.
   B. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.
   D. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Iman and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic etiquettes: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Iman; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Love; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic etiquettes:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
